coverage.finding: The pencil folio number at top left reads '51' with a raised 'b'. In native tile [0,0] it sits at about x 400–510, y 305–370, consistent with the inventory bbox. The candidate literal '51ᵇ' and its record are accurate. No other written block was found anywhere on the page.

unresolved.issue: Faint ghosted handwriting covers the ruled area. The candidate and inventory both attribute it to show-through from fol. 51, the recto of this leaf. It could instead be, or include, offset from the facing fol. 52. Mirror-reversed ghost text cannot settle this, because offset from the facing page would also appear reversed. The ghosting runs right to the bottom of the page. On fol. 51 the writing appears to stop lower down, at about 1350/1500 of that image's height, while fol. 52 is written almost to the bottom. Which side the ghosting comes from is therefore not established. Either way it is not text of fol. 51b.
unresolved.next_check: Mirror the fol. 51b image and compare the line positions of the ghost text against fol. 51 and fol. 52 at native resolution.

unresolved.issue: There are minor stray marks not listed in the inventory. One is a small diagonal tick near native x 725, y 1605. Another is a faint dashed diagonal near x 1070–1125, y 2190–2250. A small curl sits near the bottom edge at about x 2794, y 4816. Isolated dots are scattered elsewhere. All look like debris or offset rather than writing. They are not legible and none appears to be a note or holding.
unresolved.next_check: Inspect these spots at higher magnification to confirm they are not faint pencil ticks.
